name.en-US: Abridgement of the History of France

description.fr-FR: Histoire de France de Pharamond à Charles IX, composée pour le Dauphin à partir de ses leçons : règne par règne, en dix-sept livres. Écrite vers 1670-1678 par Bossuet et le Dauphin, publiée en 1747. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: A history of France from Pharamond to Charles IX, composed for the Dauphin from his lessons: reign by reign, in seventeen books. Written around 1670-78 by Bossuet and the Dauphin and published in 1747. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: História da França de Faramundo a Carlos IX, composta para o Delfim a partir de suas lições: reinado por reinado, em dezessete livros. Escrita por volta de 1670-1678 por Bossuet e pelo Delfim e publicada em 1747. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXV, pages 001-020. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.

title.fr-FR: Livre XVII : Charles IX (1560) et les règnes suivants
